summary: This tutorial covers how to customize the appearance of the jChemPaint software, including changing the background color of the panel and modifying the user interface language. To change the background color, you navigate to the Edit menu, select Preferences, then choose the FireFox Preferences window. Click on the Background Color button, select a color from the swatches or adjust using the HSB or RGB sliders, and apply the changes. For altering the look and feel of the interface, go to the Edit menu, Preferences, Other Preferences tab, and select Nimbus from the Look and Feel dropdown menu. Changing the user interface language involves selecting the Language tab in the Preferences window and choosing between American English or other languages. Templates can be included by accessing the Templates menu or using the corresponding toolbar icon, where various template options are available.
